target.name: The Hartford Income Shares Fund, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: Cutwater Asset Management Corp., the investment adviser to Rivus Bond Fund (“BDF”) (NYSE: BDF), announced today that the Board of Trustees of BDF has approved on behalf of BDF the reorganization of The Hartford Income Shares Fund, Inc. (“HSF”) (NYSE: HSF) with and into BDF (the “Reorganization”).

announcement.quote: ANNOUNCEMENT OF PROPOSED REORGANIZATION OF THE HARTFORD INCOME SHARES FUND, INC INTO RIVUS BOND FUND

deals.notes: Excerpts show the proposal, the June 15, 2010 meeting date, DEF 14A and many DEFA14A filings through 2010-09-29, but no excerpt states how it ended.
